prompt:
Use $landlord at .agents/skills/landlord/SKILL.md.

Review the proposal to replace the Cookies/CookieJar storage boundary with a plain dict[str, str] keyed only by cookie name. Recommend keep, simplify, or remove with source locations and the nearest viable alternative. Do not assume fewer layers preserve semantics. Preserve original files; do not implement the proposal, install dependencies, use network, commit or publish.

Use the preinstalled interpreter <PYTHON> for all Python/pytest commands. Do not install dependencies. Keep disposable mutation copies and diagnostic artifacts inside this project, without modifying its existing files.

Work only inside this local repository. Do not use external services or other installed skills. Do not delegate.
